training.initializedFrom: random weights; zero biases; no pretrained parameters
training.optimizer: manual BPTT and Adam with global gradient-norm clipping
training.checkpointSelection: minimum validation NLL; test never used
training.splitPolicy: contiguous disjoint document indices; no transitions between documents
training.contextPolicy: zero hidden state for each chunk; full BPTT within sequenceLength

limitations: Small character predictor; no comprehension, reasoning, instruction following, or worker acceptance.
Vocabulary comes from training only; unseen holdout characters are evaluated as UNK.
Loss uses chunks with reset state, not unlimited context or a chatbot benchmark.
A narrow authored demonstration corpus does not show performance on real user tasks.
